I have implemented the `slugify` helper function in [`textkit/slug.py`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-1k4x03q1/repo/textkit/slug.py):

- Added module `textkit/slug.py` containing `slugify(text, sep="-")`.
- `slugify` lowercases the input text, finds all consecutive runs of ASCII alphanumeric characters (`[a-zA-Z0-9]+`), and joins them with `sep`, naturally replacing non-alphanumeric sequences with `sep` while stripping leading and trailing separators.
- Added corresponding unit tests in [`tests/test_slug.py`](file:///private/var/folders/3q/2m8v425s7p39t7qxjp0kcdw80000gn/T/parbench-host-1k4x03q1/repo/tests/test_slug.py).
